title: platform-objects: `sys_exchange_rate` { currency, rate, effective_date, source } — tenant-scoped, admin-only, audited; Setup list view (multi-currency M1-1, epic #8345; released with M2)
body:
Filing gate ③ (maintainer-directed). Ruling 6465431966 on #27119 (batch #421 item 2, Q1 = 乙-现在, maintainer 「同意立专题卡」 2026-10-28): the multi-currency epic resumes on #8345 in shape C′. Part of #8345. Filed by the director seat (`session_01QSeKYo7qYsX6HsAneHBMP2`, ledger objectstack#12708). ⛔ Not a claim. Workload row and precedents: 6464936321; design: 6464438764.

Ruling-ref: 6465431966

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** 新系统对象 `sys_exchange_rate`：`currency`（ISO 4217 值域）、`rate`（1 本位币 = rate 外币，12 位有效小数）、`effective_date`、`source`（manual / import / app）；唯一键 (currency, effective_date)；租户隔离；仅组织管理员可写；审计开。Setup → Localization 下一个列表页。
- **为什么改：** 写入时折算的唯一数据源。
- **风险与回滚：** ⛔ 不单独发版：它唯一的读者是 M2-2，与 M2 同一次发布，否则是无读者的惰性对象。
- **先看：** 先例 `packages/platform-objects/src/audit/sys-*.object.ts`（142–294 行）与 `apps/setup.app.ts` 导航。
- **两分钟验证：** 管理员能录一行、非管理员被拒、同币种同日第二行被拒。
- **需要您做的：** 参数 2（仅管理员）已按默认裁定。

## Task

- [ ] Object definition + tests (uniqueness, tenant isolation, permission set, audit).
- [ ] Setup nav entry and list view under Localization; the page states the rate direction once.
- [ ] Docs line: how finance records a month's rates.

Lane: server · Size: M · Review: default. `Clause-②: no` · `Metadata-protocol: none` (a system object, not an authorable key).

Epic: #8345 (parent; the epic PM dispatches `pm:epic` children; `domain:spec` children go to the spec seat's queue). Dedupe: #8345 thread, #27119 (ruled), the workload list 6464936321; no open card carries this slice.
